problem:
Several children were asked their age. The age of each child (in years) was recorded below. If $X$ is the age of a randomly selected child, what is the expected value of $X?$

| Age | $10$ | $11$ | $12$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Number of Children | $2$ | $4$ | $4$ |

activity_context.topic_title: Expected Values of Discrete Random Variables

feedback.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Let $X$ be the value labeled on a randomly drawn card. Then the support is $S={2,5,11}.$

In the stack there are $6$ cards labeled with two, $6$ cards labeled with five, and $8$ cards labeled with eleven (twenty cards in total), so the probabilities are as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(2) & =\frac{6}{20}=\frac{3}{10} \\ P(5) & =\frac{6}{20}=\frac{3}{10} \\ P(11) & =\frac{8}{20}=\frac{2}{5}\end{aligned}
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =2\cdot f(2)+5\cdot f(5)+11\cdot f(11) \\  & =2(\frac{3}{10})+5(\frac{3}{10})+11(\frac{2}{5}) \\  & =\frac{6}{10}+\frac{15}{10}+\frac{22}{5} \\  & =\frac{6}{10}+\frac{15}{10}+\frac{44}{10} \\  & =\frac{6+15+44}{10} \\  & =\frac{65}{10} \\  & =\frac{13}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
